```yaml
name: Check AI Co-Authors

on:
  pull_request:
    types: [opened, synchronize, reopened]

jobs:
  check:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest

    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          fetch-depth: 0

      - name: Run AI co-author check
        run: |
          bash .github/scripts/check-ai-co-authors.sh
        shell: bash
```
